sources.entry: dpaste - Simple pastebin with multiple text and code option, with short url result easy to remember. (Source Code) MIT Docker/Python

summary.one_liner: dpaste is an open-source pastebin web application written in Python with the Django framework, offering short, easy-to-remember URLs for shared text and code snippets.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes dpaste as a pastebin application built on Django and says a live instance runs at dpaste.org. It can run standalone as a regular Django project or be installed into an existing Django project as a typical Django app. The README points to full documentation elsewhere and to the GitHub repository for bug reports, issues, and ideas. The README itself does not detail specific features, so the listing's note about multiple text and code options and short URLs comes from the awesome-selfhosted entry rather than the README body.
use_cases: share text with short memorable links
embed a pastebin in an existing Django site
notable: Pastebin written in Python on the Django framework
Can run standalone or as a Django app inside an existing project
Listed as a Docker-deployable self-hosted pastebin in awesome-selfhosted
caveats: README requires at minimum Python 3.9 and Django 3.2
README body gives no install or run instructions; documentation is hosted elsewhere
